highlights.title: Item receipts and names
highlights.detail: Select an item to open its details. Select a purchase to see the full receipt with the item marked. Rename an item there. Give two items the same name to show them as one item, such as a product that changed its size. Item names no longer show packaging words, and REMA's own brand shows as REMA 1000.

highlights.title: Items on phones
highlights.detail: On a phone, the item list shows the name, the size, the number of purchases and the amount spent. The item details show the other numbers.
